dish_offline.title: Dish offline
dish_offline.summary: Dish state: {{state}} — cannot reach the satellite network
recommendations: Check the power adapter and PoE cable
Restart the dish

high_latency.title: High latency
recommendations: Check for network congestion
Try restarting the router

high_packet_loss.title: Severe packet loss
recommendations: Check the PoE cable and connectors
Check whether weather is affecting the link

obstruction_detected.title: Obstruction detected
recommendations: Open the obstruction map to locate the blockage
Move or remove the obstruction

thermal_throttle.title: Dish thermal throttling
recommendations: Ensure the dish has airflow
Avoid direct sunlight on the dish

alignment_issue.title: Alignment issue
alignment_issue.summary: Attitude uncertainty {{err}}° — pointing is out of tolerance
recommendations: Use the Alignment page to fine-tune the heading
Make sure the mount is tight

motors_stowed.title: Dish stowed
motors_stowed.summary: Motors stowed the dish — it cannot aim at satellites
recommendations: Un-stow the dish in settings
Check whether an auto-stow policy triggered

gnss_positioning.title: GNSS positioning abnormal
gnss_positioning.summary: {{sats}} satellites visible — position has not converged
recommendations: Wait 5–10 minutes for convergence
Make sure the sky above the dish is open

dish_heating.title: Dish heating
dish_heating.summary: Heating is on at low temperature — dish at {{temp}}°
recommendations: Normal de-icing — it usually stops automatically
If it never stops, check the temperature sensor

slow_ethernet.title: Ethernet speed degraded
slow_ethernet.summary: Negotiated link speed is only {{speed}} Mbps
recommendations: Replace a damaged or low-quality cable
Check that the connector seats properly

cable_connectivity.title: Cable connectivity issue
recommendations: Check the PoE cable for looseness
Make sure the cable is not physically damaged

dns_resolution.title: DNS resolution abnormal
dns_resolution.summary: The dish reports a DNS issue (state {{state}})
recommendations: Check the router and system DNS settings

router_flapping.title: Router flapping
router_flapping.summary: Connected router count changed {{count}} times in the last 10 minutes
recommendations: Check the PoE cable between dish and router
Verify the router's power supply is stable

low_throughput.title: Low throughput
recommendations: Rule out heavy bandwidth usage
Check for obstructions or signal degradation

low_snr.title: Low SNR
recommendations: Check the dish's field of view
Verify elevation and heading

severe_weather.title: Severe weather impact
recommendations: It usually clears when the weather improves
If it persists, check for water or snow on the dish

high_temperature.title: Device overheating
recommendations: Improve cooling around the device
Avoid prolonged direct sunlight

poe_power.title: PoE / power issue
recommendations: Check the power adapter and PoE supply
Swap the power supply to isolate it

router_offline.title: Router offline
recommendations: Check the router's power and LEDs
Confirm the router's LAN port works

frequent_searching.title: Frequent reconnects
frequent_searching.summary: Connection state flipped {{count}} times in the last 10 minutes
recommendations: Check obstruction and heading
Verify stable power and cabling

wifi_signal.title: Wi-Fi signal issue
recommendations: Move closer to the router or add a mesh node
Switch to a less congested channel

collector_heartbeat_lost.title: Collector heartbeat lost
collector_heartbeat_lost.summary: The background collector stopped responding — data may be missing
recommendations: Restart the app to resume collection
Check whether a firewall is blocking it

service_restricted.title: Service restricted
recommendations: Check account status and plan quota
Contact your provider for the reason

service_not_activated.title: Service not activated
service_not_activated.summary: The device has not activated a subscription
recommendations: Complete the activation flow
Make sure the account is bound to this terminal

location_policy_violation.title: Location policy violation
location_policy_violation.summary: Current location does not match the authorized service area
recommendations: Confirm the terminal was not relocated
Check the service address on your account

account_suspended.title: Account suspended
account_suspended.summary: Service is suspended due to billing or policy
recommendations: Pay the balance or update payment method
Contact your provider to restore the account

roaming.title: Roaming
recommendations: Lower speeds while roaming are expected
Confirm roaming is supported in this area

no_satellite_schedule.title: No satellite schedule
no_satellite_schedule.summary: Satellite scheduling unavailable — possibly regional capacity
recommendations: Retry later — schedules are issued periodically
Check whether this area is covered

dns_failure.title: DNS resolution failure
recommendations: Check your local DNS configuration
Try a public DNS provider
dns_failure.case_user_only: Base network is fine, but your current DNS server is not responding
dns_failure.case_both: Both user and baseline DNS failed — network-layer fault or the domain does not exist
dns_failure.case_slow: Local DNS latency is clearly higher than the baseline
dns_failure.case_generic: DNS resolution failed — web pages may not load

page.title: Alerts
page.subtitle: Dish faults and network quality alerts
page.error_electron_only: Alerts are collected by the main process — open the app in Electron to view them
page.empty_history: No alert records in this time range
page.default_window_hint: Showing the last {{days}} days by default — pick a date range to see older history
page.false_positive_ack: Thanks for the feedback — this alert has been cleared and we'll keep improving detection.

shell.error_connect_timeout: Connection timed out — the Starlink dish is unreachable
shell.error_no_telemetry: Telemetry unavailable — check that the Starlink dish is connected
